character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Chibi 4-head-tall JRPG mage cadet, male, front view idle pose. Silver-white hair with pale ice-blue streaks, short tousled hair, round thin glasses. Long ivory-white military academy greatcoat with navy-blue piping and trim, tall stiff collar, navy-blue necktie, dark gloves, white trousers, tall white buckled boots. Sky-blue gem accents, ornate frost emblem. Calm cool expression, blue eyes. Dark-fantasy magic-school uniform, ivory-white and navy palette. Crisp pixel art, bold dark outline, flat cel shading.
